Title: NETMESSAGE:WELL DONE! RICHARD BODERMAN HAS BEEN DEFEATED!
Translation: 干得好！理查德·博德曼已被击败！

Title: NETMESSAGE: YOU HAVE DESTROYED THE MAJORITY OF RICHARD BODERMAN'S ARMY, NOW PREPARE TO FACE THE MAN HIMSELF!
Translation: 你已经摧毁了理查德·博德曼的大部分军队，现在准备亲自面对他本人！

Title: NETMESSAGE:Objective:\nDestroy Richard Boderman's army and rescue the captured SvenCoop members.
Translation: 目标：\n摧毁理查德·博德曼的军队并营救被俘的SvenCoop成员。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Release the members from the prison cells that are inside of the caverns.
Translation: 从洞穴内的牢房中释放成员。

Title: NETMESSAGE:The cavern entrances can be found along the paths on the inner cliffsides.
Translation: 洞穴入口可以在内崖壁的小路上找到。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Also, The caverns are heavily guarded by brainwashed members of the SvenCoop Forums.
Translation: 另外，洞穴由被洗脑的SvenCoop论坛成员严密守卫。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Use the Huey helicopter located at the helipad to gnaw away at their outer defenses.
Translation: 使用停机坪上的Huey直升机来消耗他们的外围防御。

Title: NETMESSAGE:A HIDDEN DOOR IS OPENING NEAR THE HELIPAD!
Translation: 停机坪附近的一扇隐藏门正在打开！

Title: NETMESSAGE:THE CONTROL ROOM DOORS ARE OPENING INSIDE THE PREVIOUSLY HIDDEN AREA! DESTROY BODERMAN!
Translation: 控制室的门正在之前隐藏的区域内部打开！摧毁博德曼！
